components.name: Foundation tokens
components.publicApi: CSS custom properties and logical layout rules
components.notes: Only central source for shared visual tokens.

components.name: BaseerBrand
components.publicApi: BaseerBrand({ className? })
components.notes: Brand presentation only.

components.name: BaseerButton
components.publicApi: BaseerButton with semantic variants (primary, secondary, danger, icon, quiet), semantic sizes (compact, standard, prominent, commit), and disabled state
components.notes: Future icon treatment extends this API; it is not a parallel primitive.

components.name: BaseerMenu
components.publicApi: accessible contextual menu with labelled trigger and menuitem children
components.notes: Owns compact contextual-menu focus and keyboard behavior; consumers supply menu items only.

components.name: BaseerCard
components.publicApi: BaseerCard({ children, className? })
components.notes: Token-owned surface.

components.name: BaseerTextInput
components.publicApi: forwardRef input with central class contract
components.notes: Re-exported from baseer-form-fields for compatibility.

components.name: Baseer form field primitives
components.publicApi: BaseerMoneyInput, BaseerIntegerInput, BaseerNumericSuffixInput, BaseerMonthPicker, BaseerCheckbox, BaseerTextArea and BaseerFileInput
components.notes: Money and integer values remain string-safe at the UI boundary; BaseerNumericSuffixInput keeps a visible unit inside the same field boundary.

components.name: BaseerStaticSelect
components.publicApi: labelled native select for short static options
components.notes: Use for small fixed choices, not live record lookup.

components.name: BaseerCombobox
components.publicApi: labelled searchable record selector returning stable identifiers
components.notes: Keyboard, assistive-technology, portal and remote-state behavior are implemented and covered by the control contract; further adoption remains governed by the registry ratchet.

components.name: BaseerDatePicker
components.publicApi: single business-date picker with min/max/clearable presentation
components.notes: The runtime implementation is a semantic native date input behind this one public contract; it remains registered to preserve the performance ceiling.

components.name: BaseerAriaDatePicker
components.publicApi: compatibility alias to BaseerDatePicker only
components.notes: No consumer imports this alias; it contains no second date implementation and may be removed in a breaking-change window.

components.name: BaseerDialog
components.publicApi: modal dialog with title, footer, busy/error and optional eyebrow
components.notes: The sole current generic dialog contract.

components.name: BaseerConfirmDialog
components.publicApi: confirmation composition over BaseerDialog
components.notes: Replaces browser confirmation for application actions.

components.name: BaseerFormDialog
components.publicApi: formId-linked submit/cancel dialog composition
components.notes: Uses BaseerDialog rather than a parallel dialog layer.

components.name: BaseerDataGrid
components.publicApi: typed data grid plus server load-more composition
components.notes: Does not own server cursor or business reads.

components.name: DataTable
components.publicApi: lightweight bounded table
components.notes: For bounded table presentation; specialised reports remain exceptions.

components.name: BaseerFilterBar
components.publicApi: search, filter controls, applied chips and clear action
components.notes: Does not calculate financial values or alter authorization scope.

components.name: BaseerFilterSelect and BaseerFilterToggle
components.publicApi: short native filter select and labelled checkbox toggle
components.notes: Only for short static filter choices.

components.name: BaseerFilterAutocomplete
components.publicApi: filter-owned search and selected values presentation
components.notes: Use for filter context, not form record selection.

components.name: BaseerPeriodFilter
components.publicApi: server-intent day/month/quarter/year/range period selection
components.notes: The pilot keyboard and popover contract is implemented; further adoption is governed by the registry and native-control ratchets.

components.name: BaseerValidatedForm
components.publicApi: React Hook Form and Zod composition boundary
components.notes: Client validation never replaces server business validation.

components.name: BaseerWorkspace
components.publicApi: workspace container, BaseerSectionHeader, BaseerNotice and BaseerEmptyState
components.notes: BaseerAsyncState composes state-oriented surfaces where loading, empty, error, stale or retry behavior is required.

components.name: BaseerLoadFailure
components.publicApi: safe failed-read message and retry affordance
components.notes: Will be absorbed by BaseerAsyncState without losing correlation detail.

components.name: BaseerStatusBadge
components.publicApi: labelled status tone
components.notes: Color is not the sole status signal.

components.name: BaseerSummaryMetric
components.publicApi: metric grid and labelled metric presentation
components.notes: Renders server-owned metric values.

components.name: BaseerMoney
components.publicApi: currency display with language and currency inputs
components.notes: Formatting only; no financial calculation.

components.name: BaseerChart
components.publicApi: the only ECharts lifecycle adapter plus server-owned chart presentation
components.notes: Owns ECharts registration, canvas resize and disposal; feature charts provide only server-owned series and presentation options, never direct ECharts imports or business aggregation.

components.name: BaseerSelect
components.publicApi: lazy selection facade delegating to BaseerCombobox
components.notes: Compatibility facade, not a second selection contract; it follows the verified BaseerCombobox contract.

components.name: BaseerComboboxField
components.publicApi: lazy field facade delegating to BaseerCombobox
components.notes: Compatibility facade, not a second selection contract; it follows the verified BaseerCombobox contract.

components.name: BaseerDataGridField
components.publicApi: lazy route facade delegating to BaseerDataGrid
components.notes: Performance facade; it preserves the BaseerDataGrid contract.

components.name: BaseerRequiredTextareaForm
components.publicApi: required explanation form adapter
components.notes: Narrow form composition; a generic FormField requires a separate evidence-backed decision.

components.name: BaseerValidatedFormField
components.publicApi: validated form field adapter
components.notes: Validated field adapter; ownership is explicit through the field contract and any new competing field API requires an ADR.

components.name: BaseerFormSection and BaseerFormGrid
components.publicApi: form section and responsive grid composition
components.notes: Layout only; no form state.

components.name: BaseerOutputActions
components.publicApi: authorised print and export actions
components.notes: Server reauthorizes every output request.

components.name: BaseerShareMenu
components.publicApi: bounded disclosure-style share menu
components.notes: P1 may compose a generic menu popover; it does not replace native disclosure without an ADR.

components.name: BaseerCompanyReadQuery
components.publicApi: company/session scoped simple read composition
components.notes: Not for mutations or complex cursor pagination.

components.name: Baseer batch layout
components.publicApi: BaseerWorkspaceTabs, BaseerBatchPanel, BaseerBatchHeader and BaseerBatchFooter
components.notes: ARIA tab keyboard behavior is implemented; any future tab variant remains governed by the finalization constitution and the component registry.

components.name: BaseerStepper
components.publicApi: labelled multistep workflow navigation
components.notes: Workflow composition, not a general tab substitute.

components.name: BaseerAppShell
components.publicApi: authenticated module frame with durable navigation slots
components.notes: Implementation is verified locally with authenticated desktop/mobile evidence; it remains pilot until the SHA-bound final acceptance record is issued.

components.name: BaseerNavigationDrawer
components.publicApi: mobile navigation drawer with portal, dialog semantics, focus and scroll policy
components.notes: Implementation owns portal, dialog semantics, focus and scroll policy; SHA-bound final acceptance is still required and no waiver is allowed.

components.name: BaseerAsyncState
components.publicApi: loading, empty, error, retry and stale scope composition
components.notes: Central state contract is proven by a mounted Vite harness and adopted by Basira governance reads; ready preserves children without an extra wrapper.

components.name: Baseer overlay and portal policy
components.publicApi: named base/sticky/popover/modal/toast layers and portal ownership
components.notes: All new portal overlays must select a named layer here; the drawer and portalled combobox prove the ordering contract.
